title: UserSettings
description: One person's saved profile and notification preferences (FR-SET-01, FR-SET-02, ADR-0039), stored and served by tilo-api for the verified principal only, keyed by org and user; no request names another person's. A document with version 0 is the server's unsaved defaults, never a stored record, and its updated_at is null. version counts saved writes: a write carries the version it read and is refused as stale when it is not the stored one (USET-02). Every object is closed, so an unknown field is refused. Profile email and the rest of the profile are display data: they change no sign-in identity, verified destination, directory record or connector grant (USET-06). Preferences authorise nothing and start no work (USET-07). Rules USET-01 to USET-08 are in user_settings.rules.md. $defs update is the request body of a write.

line.description: One line typed by a person, 1 to 80 characters: data, never an instruction.

email.description: A display address, at most 254 characters, with one @ and a dotted host. It is not verified and is never a recipient (USET-06).

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone name (Asia/Kolkata) or UTC, in the same shape as person.time_zone. The schema checks the shape; tilo-api also refuses a name the zone database does not know (USET-03).

language.description: A BCP 47 language tag of the drafts Tilo writes for the person: language, an optional four-letter script and an optional two-letter region (en, en-GB, zh-Hans-CN). A display name such as English (UK) is the client's label, never stored.

clock.description: A wall-clock time, HH:MM on a 24-hour clock, 00:00 to 23:59, in the zone of the object that holds it.

working_hours.description: The days and the window Tilo books inside, in profile.time_zone. start is inclusive, end exclusive, and start is before end: no overnight window (USET-03, as config/personal.yaml working_window).

profile.description: FR-SET-01. The title is null when the person has none.

channels.description: Whether one kind of notice reaches the person by phone, email and Slack. Saving a choice verifies no channel and proves no delivery.

notifications.description: FR-SET-02: the matrix, one row for each kind of notice. The decisions row keeps at least one channel on (USET-04): the rule is in the schema, so a client that skips its own guard is refused. Any other row may be all off.

money.description: An amount in the minor unit of its currency (paise, pence, cents): an integer from 1 to 1000000000000, never a float, a bool or a string with a symbol. currency is an ISO 4217 code; tilo-api refuses a code it has no minor unit for (USET-03).

quiet_hours.description: FR-SET-02 and FR-HIL-13, in the shape tilo_channels.quiet_hours.parse_quiet_hours already reads. During the window only gate and blocked notices notify; this object has no field that could hide a gate (USET-05). start and end are in timezone, the window may cross midnight, and start is never end (USET-03). threshold is typed money or null; nothing delivers by it in this release (USET-05).

update.description: The body of PUT /v1/me/settings: the whole document except what the server owns. version is the one the client read (0 when nothing was saved yet). It names no owner or org: they come from the verified principal, so a body that carries one, or updated_at, is refused (USET-01).
